### 🔫 Multiplayer
- Weapons picked up off the ground now equip properly for everyone in the room — joined players previously got the gun stuffed into their backpack unloaded and without its spare ammo.

### ⌨️ Controls
- Removed the obsolete "Map" key binding — the minimap is always on screen, so the key did nothing.
- Pressing H no longer silently switches your color profile mid-game (it was a leftover dev shortcut).
